_description: EU grant application dossier (PoCIDIF / PNRR / POCU / MySMIS). Maps to typical annex structure.
_source: Ghid Solicitant PoCIDIF 2.1 (OIPSI 2026) + euroagency.ro checklist + indais.ro

categories.name: 01_Cerere_Finantare
categories.description: Cerere de finantare MySMIS, formularul cererii, rezumat proiect, cod SMIS, formular depunere

categories.name: 02_Plan_Afaceri
categories.description: Plan de afaceri, business plan, studiu fezabilitate, analiza SWOT, proiectii financiare, previziuni venituri, analiza piata

categories.name: 03_Buget_Oferte
categories.description: Buget proiect, Anexa 6, justificari buget, oferte de pret, deviz, studii de piata, analize comparative, fundamentare costuri, facturi proforma

children.name: Buget
children.description: Buget detaliat, Anexa 6, fisiere Excel buget, rezumat cheltuieli, categorii de cheltuieli eligibile

children.name: Oferte_Semnate
children.description: Oferte de pret semnate, oferte stampilate, capturi de ecran semnate de reprezentantul legal, oferte furnizori cu semnatura

children.name: Oferte_Nesemnate
children.description: Oferte de pret nesemnate, capturi de ecran pret, screenshot-uri pagini web cu preturi hardware si software, printscreen-uri pricing pages, capturi echipamente server GPU workstation laptop switch firewall storage cloud, capturi licente SaaS

categories.name: 04_Declaratii
categories.description: Declaratii pe propria raspundere, Anexa 8 conflict de interese, declaratie efect stimulativ, declaratie IMM, declaratie ajutor de stat, declaratii eligibilitate, acord parteneriat

children.name: Anexa8_Conflict
children.description: Anexa 8 declaratie conflict de interese, formular lipsa conflict, declaratie independenta, Anexa 19

children.name: Declaratii_Eligibilitate
children.description: Declaratii eligibilitate solicitant, declaratie IMM incadrare, declaratie ajutor de stat, decizia asociat unic, declaratie efect stimulativ, declaratie conformitate, declaratie de angajament

categories.name: 05_Documente_Solicitant

children.name: ONRC_CUI
children.description: Certificat constatator, extras ONRC, CUI, cod unic inregistrare, act constitutiv, statut

children.name: Financiare
children.description: Bilant contabil, balanta de verificare, situatii financiare anuale, recipisa depunere bilant, S1003, S1005

children.name: Fiscale
children.description: Certificat atestare fiscala, cazier fiscal, certificat de inregistrare TVA

categories.name: 06_Echipa_Proiect
categories.description: Documente echipa proiect: CV-uri, diplome, certificate profesionale, contracte CIM, anexe salarizare, Anexa 9 grila, fise post

children.name: CV
children.description: CV-uri membri echipa, curriculum vitae, formular CV ACDA, rezumat experienta profesionala

children.name: Diplome_Certificate
children.description: Diplome licenta, master, doctorat, certificate profesionale, ISO, ITIL, CISA, atestari, calificari

categories.name: 10_Publicitate
categories.description: Materiale informare si publicitate: plan comunicare, oferte publicitate, diseminare, identitate vizuala, logo, banner

categories.description: Audit tehnic si financiar: oferte audit, plan audit, raport audit, certificare audit, Annexa 19 independenta auditor
